related.title: SQLite：複合索引的前綴與排序
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：從頁大小與 entry 大小估算扇出，區分內節點與葉節點的容量。 驗收紀錄必須包含通過/失敗、重現方式和剩餘限制；只對已檢查的模型範圍作結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Estimate fanout from page and entry sizes while separating internal and leaf capacities. Acceptance includes pass/fail,reproduction instructions and remaining limits; conclusions stay within the checked model.
related.difference: 比較 (department,score) 索引對雙條件查詢與只查 score 的差異。
related.differenceEn: Compare a (department,score) index for two-column predicates versus score-only queries.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: B+ 樹靠有序分支縮小搜尋；理想滿頁高度只提供下界，非資料庫實際 I/O 保證。 教學基準：floor((4096-96)/40) = 100 entries per page；第二檢核：ceil(10000/100) = 100 leaf pages。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
字典序索引先按第一欄分段，再按第二欄排序；不同查詢可利用的連續範圍不同。 教學基準：1000/10 = 100 department rows；第二檢核：20/1000*100 = 2 whole-table selectivity percent。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Ordered branching narrows B+ tree searches; ideal full-page height is a bound,not an engine I/O guarantee. Teaching baseline: floor((4096-96)/40) = 100 entries per page; second check: ceil(10000/100) = 100 leaf pages. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.

Lexicographic indexes group by the first column and sort by the second; queries expose different contiguous ranges. Teaching baseline: 1000/10 = 100 department rows; second check: 20/1000*100 = 2 whole-table selectivity percent. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.differenceEn: Recompute logical clocks for sends,receives and local events,and distinguish timestamp order from causality.

事件前先遞增；接收用 max(local,received)+1。a→b 推得 C(a)<C(b)，反向推論不成立。 教學基準：max(3,2)+1 = 4 Q receive clock；第二檢核：4+1 = 5 Q next local clock。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。

Increment for events; receive uses max(local,received)+1. Happens-before implies timestamp order,not conversely.
